title: Chapter 364
text:
A brass bullet was casually tossed into the air. The floating island flew past a dazzling star, and a ray of light shone through the buildings in the street, illuminating the spinning metal bullet. It was like a curved mirror, reflecting Han Xiao's handsome face. The bullet spun a few rounds, reached its highest point, and then slowly fell down. At this time, a drop of bright red blood splashed over. It was like a sniper had accurately hit the falling bullet.

Pa!

Han Xiao's fingers closed, and the bullet was caught. He opened his palm, and the bullet lay quietly in the middle of the black mechanical suit's glove. The cold metal was dyed with a touch of warm red.

Not far away, two groups of thugs who seemed to be Interstellar Pirates started a fight because one of them looked at the other. Roars and laughter mixed with the sound of guns and cannons were deafening. The thugs who fell to the ground found peace. Their blood was like falling plum blossoms in the wind, splattering all over the street. On the side of the street, a group of Floating Dragon Island residents hid and watched the show. Han Xiao and a few of his teammates were sitting on the scaffolding of an excavator by the street, watching the fight from afar. A splash of blood landed beside them.

"Tsk tsk, they're fighting again. How many times has it been in the past two days?" Han Xiao shook his head. He was in full mechanical suit, and his helmet was folded, revealing his head. The players around him were wrapped tightly in Sunil soldier armor.

"It's already the seventh time," Pork Bun replied immediately. A reporter's memory was indeed good.

Everyone waited patiently. The Black Star Mercenary Group had been guarding this street for two days, and they had split into several teams to guard the various intersections. In these two days, just the street that Han Xiao was in charge of had already seen seven brutes brawl. The temper of the foreign criminals was easily triggered, and the players fully understood how dangerous this place was. Three of the times, different brutes had provoked Han Xiao. Han Technician was very considerate and helped them cremate their bodies for free.

After killing three waves of brutes and showing their claws, the crowd was much quieter.

At this time, the brutes who were fighting missed their target and destroyed half of a house. It was not loud, and it crushed a few residents who were watching the show. All of a sudden, all the thugs stopped fighting. Fear appeared on their faces. They couldn't care less about anything else and scattered in all directions.

Not long after, the sound of aircraft flying past could be heard. Three low-altitude aircraft about seven to eight meters long appeared. They were dark gold in color and shaped like dragons spreading their wings. There was a pocket-sized dragon-shaped symbol on the body of the aircraft. These were the vehicles of the Dragon Guards. The three spaceships caught up with the brutes. Cannons extended from the bottom of the spaceships and shot out golden lasers, piercing through the brutes' bodies easily. After chasing for a while, and more than half of the brutes were killed, the Dragon Guards turned around and left.

Only the Dragon Guards were allowed to fly combat spaceships on the floating island. If the brutes killed civilians, the Dragon Guards would enforce the law immediately. Han Xiao had seen such situations a few times in the past two years. He felt that the rescue plan this time was really dangerous. If they could not save the captives quickly and accurately, the risk would increase exponentially if they got into a fight.

At this time, Goa sent a message. "The people of Blades have locked onto the suspect. Move out!"

Han Xiao received the location. All the mercenaries joined the same channel and shared the location of the suspect. At this time, the suspect had just landed at the dock and was escorting large metal boxes. It was a team of slave traders. One of the mercenaries in Blades had the transformation ability and turned into a beast that was half wolf and half dog. His sense of smell was extremely sensitive. He smelled the scent of the Silvers on these slave traders and locked onto the target.

Porter, Black Star, you guys bring people over quietly and ambush them on their route. We have more people, so we have to destroy the enemy with one strike. Don't get into a fight. Goa, you take the people of the Circle and guard the perimeter. If we fail, you'll be our insurance. "

Since the target had been locked onto, there was no need to continue following them. The plan sounded quite reliable. Since everyone was on the same side, Han Xiao naturally had no objections. He gathered all the members of Black Star and split up to go to the ambush location that Cerleni had set up. It was right at the border between the dock and the city, so it was very chaotic.

…

Peggy walked down from the spaceship. All the slaves were placed in large boxes that were electrified, controlled by shackles and self-destruct collars, waiting to be brought to the buyer.

Thinking that they were about to be sold for a large sum of money, this group of scavengers was excited. Peggy was not that excited. He led the team and went to Horlaide's slave market.

Entering the dock street, this team of slave traders was very conspicuous and attracted the attention of a large group of brutes on the street. Many people were tempted. Some recognized Peggy and greeted him from afar. Peggy was a famous slave trader in the Shattered Star Ring. He had business dealings with many pirates and scavengers. He had some reputation, so he would not be attacked on Floating Dragon Island.

After walking for a while, Peggy suddenly stopped. His pupils constricted, and his vertical pupils almost became a line. His head gradually flattened like it was going to become a snake's head. The snake scales on his body became clear and tough. Peggy was a shapeshifting Esper. Some kind of snake bloodline in his body had undergone atavism. He had extremely sharp senses and early warning. He sensed that someone was following him, and there was a faint murderous intent in the air. His strong intuition told him that he would encounter something if he continued to walk forward.

"Oh, the smell of an enemy. Is it coming for me? Who could it be?" Peggy's eyes were cold. He stopped, waved his hand, and said, "Go back the way you came, return to the spaceship."

Then he turned on the communicator. "My dear Horlaide, I've arrived at Floating Dragon Island. Come and get the goods yourself this time."

Horlaide was confused. "What's wrong with you? You used to send the goods over. Why do you want me to go this time? Also, why did you transform for no reason? You look like a snake. Too ugly."

"I sensed murderous intent," Peggy said impatiently. "Someone is targeting me. Humph, it's probably related to the captives this time. I think someone wants to steal the goods. I'll wait for you on the spaceship."

"It's too troublesome for me to get the goods," Horlaide said with dissatisfaction. "I don't want to go to a dock full of pirates and scavengers."

"Then ask the Dragon Guards to protect you. You're the leader's subordinate anyway, so you definitely have the ability to ask the Dragon Guards for help."

"I think you're just giving me a hard time." Horlaide's face fell. He did not have the authority to order the Dragon Guards around. Although they belonged to the same organization, if he wanted to ask them for help, he would have to give them money. He did not like any behavior that increased the cost.

However, Peggy insisted on his opinion and believed in his vigilance. He would not take any chances. Horlaide had no choice but to compromise. The two of them hung up.

"Why did they turn back?" The Blade Legion's tracker had a puzzled look on his face as he sent the news to Porter.

Furthermore, in the streets far away, Han Xiao, Cerleni, and Porter had already set up an ambush with their respective troops. When they received the message, they all frowned.

"Attention, the target did not continue forward. According to the route, he seems to be returning to the spaceship. Did the negotiation with the buyer fall through?" Porter was confused.

Because Peggy had finally shown his face, Cerleni searched the army's archives and found Peggy's information. He was shocked. "This is not good. That scavenger is called Peggy. His Esper Ability is to transform into a snake. He has extremely strong senses, close to short-term foresight. He might have sensed danger!"

Originally, they did not want to alert the snake, but this snake was too sensitive. It had already been alerted, and the other party had become vigilant.

At this time, Goa, who was guarding outside, sent a message with a serious tone. "There's an accident. Horlaide left the slave market and seems to be heading to the dock. It's very likely that the buyer will pick up the goods himself."

Everyone's expression changed. Han Xiao thought for a while and said, "Then there's no other way. We'll kill our way over and save them. We can't let the two sides meet up. Our time is limited, so it's best to act now."

The original plan was not bad, but the situation was very unpredictable. Cerleni felt that Han Xiao was right. They could only attack in haste now. He told everyone to get close to the target quickly. At the same time, he gave another order for a few people to start the spaceship in advance. When the time came, they would grab the hostage and leave immediately.

Peggy returned to the dock that was filled with brutes. When he was still a few hundred meters away from the spaceship, the mercenaries finally approached him.

"Go!" Cerleni did not have time to care about anything else. With a roar, more than two hundred mercenaries tore off their disguises. Their battle suits changed shape, and all kinds of abilities exploded, charging toward Peggy's team!

Han Xiaoxin's mechanical suit quickly extended a helmet to protect his head. He turned around and said, "Let's go, too."

He took out his electromagnetic gun, fired from afar, and charged forward. Behind him, more than fifty players in the same armor raised their large-caliber machine guns and charged forward like a flood of steel!

"There are indeed enemies!" Peggy narrowed his eyes. He had been on guard for a long time. He had his men quickly pull out their guns and shoot. He was very cunning. He quietly shot at the other brutes and dragged the other gangs into this.

The dock was a huge square. There were no residents; they were all outsiders. This was the most dangerous place. The mercenaries and Peggy exchanged fire. Bullets rained down. Many stray bullets hit the brutes nearby, and there was a roar.

"Who's hitting me?"

"Ouch, my eyes!"

"Damn mercenaries, do you want to kill us?"

The dock was the most chaotic. Groups of brutes were also affected and joined the battle.

A chaotic battle broke out!
